definitions.explanation: The larva of a fly. It breeds in rotting food and garbage.

examples.japanese: {生|なま}ごみ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ウジ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}いていた→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧。
examples.english: Maggots had bred in the kitchen garbage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{生|なま}ごみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}さない→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、ハエ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{産|う}んで→産む：01899_umu⟧ウジ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}いて→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧しまう。
examples.english: In summer, if you don't put out kitchen scraps quickly, flies lay eggs and maggots appear.

notes:
Written {蛆|うじ} in kanji, usually in katakana or hiragana. The verb is ⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧, as if the maggots sprang up by themselves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ウジ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湧|わ}く→湧く：13321_waku_welling⟧: maggots breed
- ウジ{虫|むし}: maggot; also an insult (worm, vermin)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{蠅|はえ}→蠅：05013_hae⟧: fly
- ⟦{幼虫|ようちゅう}→幼虫：16411_youchuu⟧: larva
